universe: Society Wives — Five Veils of Desire

episode.title: Five Doors, Eleven Worlds
episode.subtitle: An Ordinary Day of Unordinary Impressions
episode.setting: Gurgaon · Gulmohar Heights / Cyber City / school / CA firm / hospital / police station
episode.laneDefinition: Five personal society/home lanes + five professional lanes + one shared crossover lane = eleven story environments

leads.name: Ankita
leads.society: Rinku, Rajeev, Sharmi and society residents
leads.workplace: Vivan, Reyansh, Rohit, Priya, Nisha, Diya, Kavita and team
leads.visual: Expressive eyes, elegant workwear, confident style; attractiveness is an adult character trait, not a substitute for competence.

leads.name: Shivani
leads.society: Deepu, event circle, Sharmi and family
leads.workplace: Harsh, Laksh, Pooja and school staff
leads.visual: Warm smile, graceful manner, practical kurta and saree styling.

leads.name: Taniya
leads.society: Guddu, Soniya, Rahul and neighbour circle
leads.workplace: Raghav, Chirag, Neha and audit staff
leads.visual: Stylish, expressive and playful; energy is a major part of her appeal.

leads.name: Meenakshi
leads.workplace: Dr. Ritesh, Nurse Rupa, Naveen and hospital staff
leads.visual: Composed, elegant and poised; her confidence in clinical decisions shapes first impressions.

leads.name: Shreya
leads.workplace: Inspector Chauhan, Poonam, Javed and station staff
leads.visual: Strong posture, attentive eyes, commanding but approachable presence.

scenes.title: The pin and the morning call
narration: Ankita stood by the hallway mirror, checking a cream kurti beneath her blazer. She was an IT tech lead; her presentation bag was heavy with a laptop, charger and a notebook covered in project sketches. Kabir had already put two cups of tea on the counter.

Rajeev, Kabir's father, read the newspaper by the window. Ankita spoke easily with him about the society notice. His attention was familial in this scene; no attraction is inferred from everyday care.

dialogue.speaker: Kabir
dialogue.line: Release day. Breakfast, or are you taking three emails for breakfast again?

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: You finish your tea. I'll finish the release and still come home before you.

dialogue.speaker: Kabir
dialogue.line: Bold claim. I'm keeping the receipt.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Keep the receipt, not my charger.

dialogue.speaker: Rajeev
dialogue.line: The lift service is at seven. Take the other one.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Noted, Papa. I will be careful.

internal: Ankita finds Kabir's joking reassuring. A repeated thought about workplace pressure, not another man, is what occupies her morning.

scenes.title: Two minutes before the bell
narration: Shivani, a teacher, has already revised Tara's homework and put a red kurta under a light dupatta. Rohan is searching for his car keys. Their warm morning chaos is familiar, not a newly introduced marriage.
Deepu, the society event helper, returns a misplaced notice board clip at the door and smiles at her efficient organisation. She thanks him politely; there is no flirtation here.

dialogue.speaker: Rohan
dialogue.line: Where are my keys?

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Same place as yesterday. Under your own files.

dialogue.speaker: Rohan
dialogue.line: How do you remember everything?

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Teacher training.

dialogue.speaker: Deepu
dialogue.line: Madam, tomorrow's event posters. You wanted the final print?

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: After school. Please check with Sharmi too.

internal: She likes Rohan's teasing, and she knows the society often relies on her. Deepu's thanks registers as ordinary help.

scenes.title: Two calendars, one wedding
narration: Taniya has an audit file open while Aditya, her fiancé, calls about their upcoming family lunch. She is younger than the other four leads but already respected at work. Her office identity cannot be reduced to wedding planning.
Guddu hands her a courier marked with an urgent client seal. He is respectful and lightly impressed by how confidently she deals with the mix-up; Taniya does not treat it as a romantic encounter.

dialogue.speaker: Aditya (phone)
dialogue.line: Sunday lunch with both families. Locked?

dialogue.speaker: Taniya
dialogue.line: Locked, as long as nobody audits the menu.

dialogue.speaker: Guddu
dialogue.line: Ma'am, they brought the wrong floor number again.

dialogue.speaker: Taniya
dialogue.line: Then at least our building is consistent. Thank you, Guddu.

dialogue.speaker: Soniya (phone)
dialogue.line: Did you say yes to everything again?

dialogue.speaker: Taniya
dialogue.line: No. Just the important things.

internal: She is excited about marrying Aditya, and equally determined not to lose her independence.

scenes.title: Before the hospital shift
narration: Meenakshi finishes a brief conversation with Vihaan about his school schedule. Nikhil has prepared breakfast, knowing she may not be able to eat at the hospital.

Babloo, who helps coordinate pharmacy deliveries for the society, confirms a neighbour's prescription parcel. Meenakshi thanks him for handling the request responsibly. The attention here is professional trust, not romantic interest.

dialogue.speaker: Nikhil
dialogue.line: Can we count on you for dinner?

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: If the ward lets me leave on time, absolutely.

dialogue.speaker: Nikhil
dialogue.line: Then I'll keep your portion warm.

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: You always do.

dialogue.speaker: Babloo
dialogue.line: Doctor madam, the parcel is with security.

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: Good. Please hand it only to the family member on the form.

internal: She notices Nikhil's care and the small relief of being understood, even as duty takes priority.

scenes.title: Off duty for eleven minutes
narration: Shreya heads toward the station in a crisp practical outfit. Vikram helps Anaya with her school bag and jokes that his wife is already inspecting the society gate.

Chintu, the society security operations helper, reports an entry-register inconsistency. Shreya explains a process rather than giving him orders. He admires her discipline, but no attraction is established.

dialogue.speaker: Vikram
dialogue.line: Inspector madam, breakfast is not an official inquiry.

dialogue.speaker: Shreya
dialogue.line: It is when someone stole the last toast.

dialogue.speaker: Vikram
dialogue.line: Anaya will never confess.

dialogue.speaker: Chintu
dialogue.line: Madam, yesterday's visitor record has a mismatch.

dialogue.speaker: Shreya
dialogue.line: Write down the vehicle number, don't guess. We can review it tonight.

internal: Shreya values her husband's humour. She likes being respected in the society, but she is not interested in being admired merely for her uniform.

scenes.title: The woman who leads the release
narration: At the IT office, Priya from QA checks the test evidence while Nisha, the junior Java developer, moves through a bug list. Diya brings a revised UI; Kavita from HR collects the day's onboarding notes. Ankita is not the only woman here, and the women have jobs and opinions independent of her attractiveness.

Vivan and Reyansh have worked with Ankita before. Vivan's expressive confidence contrasts with Reyansh's quieter, more observational manner. The team knows Ankita has an eye for clean solutions and a polished personal style.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.line: The login issue is fixed, but I still want one regression run.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Agreed. No release before the evidence.

dialogue.speaker: Vivan
dialogue.line: The new screen looks good, but your presentation will make it look much better.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: You can compliment the slide after it passes QA.

dialogue.speaker: Reyansh
dialogue.line: I'll take the API timings. The numbers are still uneven.

dialogue.speaker: Nisha
dialogue.line: I can help verify the fallback.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Good. Pair up and send one report, not five messages.

internal: Vivan's light teasing is familiar, and Ankita notices it. She likes his creative confidence a little, but does not assume he wants a relationship. Reyansh privately finds her attractive; she has no knowledge of a deeper private wish.

scenes.title: The rehearsal that would not fit
narration: Shivani's colleague Pooja brings the rehearsal schedule. Harsh and Laksh are helping coordinate stage logistics. Shivani knows Harsh enjoys making her laugh during long days; she does not mistake it for a commitment.
Her smile and organised manner make her noticeable. Her reaction to attention depends on whether it comes with respect for her work.

dialogue.speaker: Pooja
dialogue.line: We have twenty minutes less than the plan.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Then we lose a song, not the children’s safety checks.

dialogue.speaker: Harsh
dialogue.line: You solved the whole rehearsal before I found a marker.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: That's because you looked for a speech first.

dialogue.speaker: Laksh
dialogue.line: I'll move the projector. The cable is safer on the left.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Perfect. Thank you.

internal: She is amused by Harsh and appreciates Laksh's reliability. She doesn't yet feel romantic attraction to either.

scenes.title: The numbers and the joke
narration: Taniya and Neha work through a client's unusual balance. Raghav and Chirag share the next desk. Their banter is familiar enough to be playful without interrupting the work. Taniya is stylish and outgoing, but the team also knows she can spot accounting errors quickly.

Raghav enjoys both her energy and their competitive exchanges. Chirag notices her appearance and briefly imagines an uncomplicated evening outside work, but never voices it. Taniya has no reason to know his private thought.

dialogue.speaker: Neha
dialogue.line: These two totals don't reconcile.

dialogue.speaker: Taniya
dialogue.line: Then we shouldn't pretend they do.

dialogue.speaker: Raghav
dialogue.line: One coffee says I'll find the reason first.

dialogue.speaker: Taniya
dialogue.line: You already owe me two coffees.

dialogue.speaker: Chirag
dialogue.line: I should have started keeping score.

dialogue.speaker: Taniya
dialogue.line: Maybe first start checking the footnotes.

internal: Raghav's easy humour gives her a flicker of curiosity; Chirag reads more into the playfulness than she does. She remains committed to Aditya.

scenes.title: The doctor who stays calm
narration: Nurse Rupa updates the ward chart as Meenakshi reviews a medication discrepancy. Naveen from hospital administration brings a corrected form. Dr. Ritesh Anand joins her to check the safest solution.
Her composure draws Dr. Ritesh's interest beyond simple appearance: he appreciates how she listens, thinks and acts under pressure.

dialogue.speaker: Rupa
dialogue.line: The earlier chart was printed before the correction.

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: Then we confirm it with the treating team before anything changes.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Ritesh
dialogue.line: You caught that before the round. Good judgment.

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: Rupa caught it. We checked it together.

dialogue.speaker: Naveen
dialogue.line: I'll replace the form at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: Thank you, Naveen.

internal: Meenakshi recognises Ritesh's support and feels seen as a capable doctor. She has not defined that feeling as romance.

scenes.title: Command without raising her voice
narration: Shreya reviews a duty report while Poonam, a fellow officer, checks the timeline. Javed has prepared the incident summary. Inspector Chauhan joins the briefing, questioning a procedural gap.
Chauhan notices Shreya's quick reasoning and calm authority. Shreya respects his discipline. Any further interest is only a quiet possibility, and their work hierarchy cannot be ignored.

dialogue.speaker: Poonam
dialogue.line: The entry time differs from the first statement.

dialogue.speaker: Shreya
dialogue.line: Good catch. Flag it, don't overwrite it.

dialogue.speaker: Chauhan
dialogue.line: That was the right call.

dialogue.speaker: Shreya
dialogue.line: The file must tell the truth, even if the truth is inconvenient.

dialogue.speaker: Javed
dialogue.line: I'll attach both reports.

dialogue.speaker: Shreya
dialogue.line: Do that. Keep the original too.

internal: Shreya registers Chauhan's unusual approval but is much more interested in finishing the case correctly.

scenes.title: The compliment after the fix
narration: The release passes its verification. Vivan returns the projector remote while Priya signs off the QA evidence. Reyansh has already posted the performance summary. The team begins dispersing for lunch.
Ankita is pleased by the work and by Vivan's ability to make a stressful day feel lighter. The thought is a quiet beginning, not a decision to pursue him.

dialogue.speaker: Vivan
dialogue.line: You always look completely in control.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: That's because you only see the final slide.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.line: For the record, she was furious at the broken test at nine.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Professionally furious.

dialogue.speaker: Vivan
dialogue.line: Still impressive.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Lunch, Vivan. Before I give you another ticket.

internal: Ankita smiles after he leaves, then tells herself the release went well. The smile has more than one possible cause.

scenes.title: Five people, five versions of the evening
narration: Sharmi's event message brings the five women to the courtyard at staggered moments. Ankita arrives from office, Shivani after checking Tara's dinner, Taniya with a wedding-planning call still pending, Meenakshi after her hospital shift, and Shreya after changing out of her work clothes.

Mahendra Suri introduces the community-week schedule. Rohan and Kabir arrive as spouses, Nikhil checks on Meenakshi, and Vikram offers to organise safety volunteers. Aditya joins by phone because he is not yet part of Taniya's household. Soniya and Rahul stop by on their way home.

Rajeev briefly notices Shivani's graceful confidence while she manages the noticeboard. She is unaware of this fleeting attention. Rahul admires Ankita's quick problem-solving and privately wonders about getting to know her better outside a group setting; Ankita interprets his comments as routine courtesy. Neither thought is treated as a mutual relationship.

dialogue.speaker: Sharmi
dialogue.line: I need five different brains, not five people agreeing with Mahendra-ji.

dialogue.speaker: Mahendra
dialogue.line: I heard that.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: I'll handle registrations if the data is actually organised.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: I'll coordinate the children's programme.

dialogue.speaker: Taniya
dialogue.line: Accounts and vendor payments are mine.

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: I'll check the health-camp requirements.

dialogue.speaker: Shreya
dialogue.line: And please, one actual entry register for volunteers.

dialogue.speaker: Rahul
dialogue.line: That sounds like the most efficient committee in Gurgaon.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Ask us again after the first spreadsheet.

dialogue.speaker: Rohan
dialogue.line: I'm keeping the first-aid kit for the committee debates.

internal: Everyone enjoys the comfortable group atmosphere. Several private impressions coexist, but no woman is obligated to recognise or return any man's interest.

scenes.title: The smile that stayed
narration: Kabir asks about the release. Ankita recounts Priya's QA objections and Vivan's joke. She laughs at the memory, then returns to discussing tomorrow's work.
She does not hide a relationship because there is no relationship to hide. Her attraction remains an untested thought.

dialogue.speaker: Kabir
dialogue.line: So did your famous release survive?

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Barely. Priya saved us from an embarrassing bug.

dialogue.speaker: Kabir
dialogue.line: And tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Tomorrow they'll find a new way to surprise me.

internal: She remembers Vivan's confidence for a moment, but her attention returns to her marriage and work.

scenes.title: A compliment with no conclusion
narration: Rohan helps tidy up while Shivani checks the school rehearsal photos. Harsh's exaggerated praise has become a funny office memory; she has not invited anything personal.
Rohan sees a tired wife relieved by a successful rehearsal and makes her laugh.

dialogue.speaker: Rohan
dialogue.line: Did the stage survive?

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Mostly. Harsh nearly made the projector a cast member.

dialogue.speaker: Rohan
dialogue.line: Then he deserves a credit.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Only if I get director.

internal: She is fond of Rohan; a colleague's admiration stays an ordinary, slightly flattering memory.

scenes.title: One coffee wager
narration: Taniya reads an audit-group message confirming that Raghav found the missing footnote. Aditya calls to ask about Sunday lunch. She replies cheerfully and does not turn the coffee wager into a private invitation.
Her curiosity about Raghav is a small present-tense feeling, not a betrayal or a planned encounter.

dialogue.speaker: Aditya (phone)
dialogue.line: You sound pleased with yourself.

dialogue.speaker: Taniya
dialogue.line: We fixed a problem. Also, somebody owes me coffee.

dialogue.speaker: Aditya
dialogue.line: That's not a new condition.

dialogue.speaker: Taniya
dialogue.line: It's practically a professional benefit.

internal: She privately wonders why Raghav's challenge made the workday so enjoyable, then closes the chat.

scenes.title: The person who noticed
narration: Nikhil listens as Meenakshi describes a difficult shift. Dr. Ritesh's praise remains a kind moment from work, but the person she talks to about it is her husband.
She values being appreciated by colleagues and understood at home. The emotions are separate.

dialogue.speaker: Nikhil
dialogue.line: You did the right thing.

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: The whole team did.

dialogue.speaker: Nikhil
dialogue.line: You can say you did a good job too.

dialogue.speaker: Meenakshi
dialogue.line: I'll try.

internal: She finds Ritesh's calm judgment interesting, but has no intention to turn that into a romantic plan.

scenes.title: Two kinds of respect
narration: Shreya comes home to Vikram and Anaya. Before dinner she sets aside the files she has been thinking about. Inspector Chauhan's approval does not alter her decisions or family obligations.
Tomorrow the society volunteer plan will require her attention. Tonight, the family gets it.

dialogue.speaker: Vikram
dialogue.line: Still mentally at the station?

dialogue.speaker: Shreya
dialogue.line: Halfway out.

dialogue.speaker: Vikram
dialogue.line: Then dinner is phase two of the operation.

dialogue.speaker: Shreya
dialogue.line: Approved.

internal: She notices that respect from Chauhan felt meaningful, but does not label it attraction.

notes: This is a fresh universe; prior Society_Story archive names and roles are explicitly non-canon.
Dhika is a reference for narrative techniques only; no fictional universe connection.
Male private fantasy is a narrative thought, not consent or reciprocal attraction.
No explicit sexual descriptions. No intimate or non-consensual actions occur in this prologue.
All younger adults are 18+; children remain family-only.
Prologue anchors only first impressions; future events require separate episode approval.
Ledger intentionally separates attraction from affection, friendship and work respect; private wish does not indicate another person's consent.
Rohit is professional admiration only in EP00; any later romantic change requires an approved scene.
Previous EP00 prologue was renumbered to EP01 at the user's explicit direction. This change does not authorize Episode 02 canon.
